root_cause.text: The PCI endpoint NTB initialization code failed to verify the return value of `alloc_workqueue()`, allowing a NULL pointer dereference if memory allocation fails.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that missing error checking after `alloc_workqueue()` may lead to a NULL pointer dereference, and the patch adds an explicit `if (!kpcintb_workqueue)` check returning `-ENOMEM` immediately after the allocation call in `drivers/pci/endpoint/functions/pci-epf-ntb.c` and `pci-epf-vntb.c`.
